title: Rihal Code Model Profiles
description: Schema for model profiles. Each profile is a complete mapping of every agent to a model tier.

profiles.description: Named profiles (quality, balanced, budget, inherit). Each profile defines a model per agent.

agents.description: Map of agent name → model tier (opus/sonnet/haiku) or 'inherit' or fully-qualified model ID

default_profile.description: Profile to use when no project-level override is set
